what: The commenter says they are going back to analog for 2026 because their favorite layout is no longer working for them, and says Etsy now feels like a sea of copycat designs.
verbatim_snippet:
"I switched from paper to digital 5 yrs ago and liked it very much, because there were weekly layouts that weren't available in paper planners. But for 2026 I'm going back to analog because my favorite layout is no longer working for me and it appears the innovation in design has shifted back to paper planner designers. Even the large companies like Plum Paper and Erin Condren are offering many new options, and MAMBI (Happy Planner) is pushing the envelope with their Citrine line at Office Depot.
Etsy, once a showcase for indie designers, now feels like a sea of copycat designs."
